cohort: 34,178 women who gave birth after 28 weeks of gestation between January 2015 and August 2019 in Guangzhou Medical Centre for Critical Pregnant Women, China
finding: Maternal age < 18 years, previous cesarean section, history of PPH, conception through IVF, pre-delivery anemia, stillbirth, prolonged labor, placenta previa, placental abruption, PAS, and macrosomia were risk factors for SPPH.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was a risk factor for SPPH (aOR = 2.57, 95% CI: 1.90-3.47).
